notes.title: Post-launch Update!
notes.notes:
Check out what's new in Journey to Monolith's first post-launch update!

New Units
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/4eb4ac5f6f0a44dc7d5e11a8a72f3b633bdafe3c.gif
Silverguard Knight
This LYONAR support unit boasts a decent DEFENSE stat and immediately gives a temporary boost to your leading fighter's ATTACK stat with its ability Rallying Charge at the start of Combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/12f3950bb5e675beec2d2c719d96bf371cf89f70.gif
Silithar Egg
Nurse this defenseless MAGMAR egg through a handful of turns during Combat, and it will evolve into a Young Silithar!  Once it hatches it's ready to fight, but you can also keep it on the backline until it evolves again... and again!  Keep it safe by powering up its HP or ARMOR stat, or pair it with attacks like Overgrowth to accelerate its growth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/621592b5266f525026491dab6c7c834d3b17ce89.gif
Snowchaser
The new VANAR fighter doesn't have a lot of DEFENSE or HP, but its ability Shielded Entry, gives it some ARMOR each time it switches in.  Use that extra staying power to lauch support moves like Protective Field, Weapon Lock, or Icestorm.


New Enemies

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/fe253865a571b902e92bbe72106dc2316d7e7065.gif
Silvertongue Corsair
Watch out for this pirate's ability, Fight Dirty, which gives a temporary debuff to your active unit's ATTACK stat when it switches in.  Hopefully you aren't putting all your eggs in one basket and can switch out to remove the stat drop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/65daef5c1b81333f4d4e1a211142e14170764e00.gif
Deathblighter
This dangerous cat serves as a hard-counter to strategies centering around Mini-Jax - while it's still alive, it reduces the damage of ALL Mini-Jax to ZERO!  Good thing it doesn't have a ton of HP or DEFENSE, so once you get it in the active spot it should come down easily.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/3fc872fff230fdd0c3d1e7408d2bffc86cec0542.gif
Mirrorrim
If you like buffing up one strong fighter and then cleaning up, watch out for Mirrorrim!  When it switches in, its ability Mirror Image copies the opposing unit's stats completely - try to take it down before you power up your end-game sweeper!

New Elite

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/bd40ea45b5700e27e2c1e480e65f0a6e7729fced.gif
Protector
You'll need to decent firepower to push through this Elite unit's high DEFENSE and ARMOR.  Thankfully it doesn't have much ATTACK power, but its ability Regenerating Armor gives it more ARMOR between turns, so don't let it sit for too long or it will wear you down before you know it!

notes.title: Journey to Monolith will release August 1st, 2024!
notes.notes:
Start planning your trek and crafting your perfect team, because Journey to Monolith is set to release August 1st, 2024!

Choose your general, build your team, customize your fighters, and battle your way to the Monolith in this strategic, turn-based roguelite game.

While the game will launch with over 50 different playable units and 60 spells across six unique factions, I plan to keep working on the game after release with new fighters, new enemies, new spells, and new attacks so that each run will truly feel unique!

Want to talk with me directly about the game?  Join the Discord!  https://discord.gg/MsS2m4t8Hp

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
- Updated UI (additional tooltips, progress bar updates, "switch" button rework

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/f3fa97f5cff2c90899402bff3377c696f7351cef.png


- New COMBAT LOG for easy reference during battle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/799c125a0a77afd1763e656da58a4d05879b8351.png

This new quality of life feature will show the last several turns of the battle, in case you missed what attack was used by the enemy, or want to show off that perfect switch to your friends.  Easily toggle-able on the right-hand side of the combat screen!


- New early game enemy, the "Dragonlark"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44797047/854aa04b1fcbf8e6940700a62b2b8783cdccb12d.gif

This fearless flyer has good speed and moderate attack, but not a ton of healthpoints or defense.  Take it out quickly before it can support its teammates with its Mayhem attack, which gives a random ally more Attack power!
